creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`pane new --run` waits for the new pane's shell to print something before typing, so a program still starting up does not miss the command. No test shows the wait changing an outcome: it was removed and the suite passed three times, because a pty buffers and a plain shell runs early input anyway.

The wait is a precaution against a program that resets the terminal as it starts and discards what is pending, which is what a full-screen agent harness does and what `sh` will not do on demand. So either find a program that reproduces it and pin the wait, or decide the buffering is enough and take the wait out - the current state is code carrying an unproven claim.

Stated in `crates/muster-herdr/tests/pane_equipping.rs` and in `HerdrBackend::start`'s own doc.
title: 🕰️ Nothing shows the readiness wait before a pane's first command matters
